title: Login with valid credentials
steps: Go to the login page. Enter a valid username and password. Submit the form. User lands on the inventory page.

title: Add an item to the cart from the product list
steps: From the inventory page, click Add to cart on any product. The cart badge should increment.

title: View a product's detail page
steps: From the inventory page, click a product's title or image. The product detail page should show its name, description, and price.

title: View shopping cart contents
steps: Open the cart from the header icon. The cart page should list every item that was added.

title: Proceed to checkout and enter shipping information
steps: From the cart page, click Checkout. Enter first name, last name, and postal code. Click Continue.

title: Complete an order successfully
steps: After entering shipping info and continuing, click Finish on the overview page. The order confirmation page should be shown.

title: Remove an item from the cart
steps: From the cart or product page, click Remove on an item that was previously added. The item should no longer be in the cart.

title: Login with an invalid password shows an error
steps: Enter a valid username with an incorrect password. Submit. An error message should be shown and the user should stay on the login page.

title: User can log out of the application
steps: While logged in, open the menu and click Logout. The user should be returned to the login page and the session should end.

title: Sort inventory items by price
steps: On the inventory page, use the sort dropdown to order items low to high. The list should re-order accordingly.
